name: OSS_ASSET_DEFAULT_VALUES
description: Table for asset transaction default values.

columns.name: DEFAULT_VALUE_ID
columns.description: Primary key for asset transaction default values.

columns.name: DEFAULT_VALUE_CODE
columns.description: Alternate key for asset transaction default values.

columns.name: BUSINESS_UNIT_ID
columns.description: Default business unit identifier for included warranty creation.

columns.name: SUBSCRIPTION_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Default subscription profile identifier for asset transactions.

columns.name: CLOSE_REASON
columns.description: Default close reason for asset transactions.

columns.name: CANCEL_REASON
columns.description: Default cancellation reason for asset transactions.

columns.name: CLOSE_CREDIT_METHOD
columns.description: Default close credit method for asset transactions.

columns.name: TRANSFER_OPTION
columns.description: Default transfer option for asset transfer.

columns.name: WARRANTY_UPGRADE_OPTION
columns.description: Default upgrade option for warranty asset upgrade.

columns.name: COVERAGE_UPGRADE_OPTION
columns.description: Default upgrade option for coverage asset upgrade.

columns.name: HOLD_PROCESSING
columns.description: Default hold processing flag for asset transactions.

columns.name: EDIT_STANDARD_COVERAGE_YN
columns.description: Default edit standard coverage for include warranty

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
